claims.text: Many reviewers praise the wig as soft, realistic-looking, and good quality for the price.
Several reviewers report shedding and tangling, sometimes severe.
Some reviewers find the wig too thin or poorly constructed, with issues like a hump at the top or a huge cap.
Reviewers frequently mention the blunt cut and easy styling/maintenance as positives.
A few reviewers note a smell upon arrival that goes away after washing.
